Foundations

Jade instead of the navy-and-gold every legal product reaches for. One tint does every interactive job; oxide and ochre are reserved for legal status and never borrowed for decoration.

Screens — iOS, 390×844

Pinterest's structure with text as the hero: cards to browse, sheets for detail, generous whitespace. No fake status bar — the real one renders on top on a device.
The citation chip and the provenance sheet are not styling. They are how the grounding guarantee becomes something a person can check — two taps from any claim to the statutory text it rests on.
